doc.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Wrapping up
summary: Brower says there is much more to talk about and Fuller agrees they repeat themselves.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing the interview: thanks, goodbyes and tape running out

blocks.x: You know, I think we should wrap. As with all of these opportunities to talk with the greats in this music, I feel like we just scratched something and, you know I could spend like a week-­

Well, but it would – – there may be things that would be repeated but, it is like when you do another interpretation, there will be something else there that wasn't there before. There will be another idea that will come.
That’s what we are. We are not going to ever do something the same way.
There is just so much more we could do. If you want to leave us with a parting thought, or something that you want on the record that we did not ask about, maybe we have five minutes or so.
